seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Mount Holly, NC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Mount Holly, NC: the annual Christmas Parade down Central Avenue and Main Street on December 5, 2026.
lede: Mount Holly keeps Christmas simple and local, with an annual parade down Central Avenue and Main Street in its historic downtown.
celebrates: The City of Mount Holly presents its annual Christmas Parade in historic downtown, moving down Central Avenue and Main Street with what the Gaston County calendar calls magical and creative displays of the Christmas spirit for spectators of all ages. The parade falls on the same afternoon as Kings Mountain's festival and Dallas's parade, and a few days after Belmont's. Families can also look at the lights in McAdenville, the Gaston County town known as Christmas Town U.S.A., a short drive away.
lastyear: Mount Holly's parade is a fixed date on the Gaston County calendar each year, listed this year for Saturday, December 5, at 3 pm. Go Gaston NC includes it in its county parade guide, along with Belmont, Cramerton, Dallas, Gastonia, Kings Mountain, McAdenville and others. We could not find a published 2025 recap, so the detail here comes from the 2026 listings.
facts: Mount Holly's parade moves down Central Avenue and Main Street, according to the Gaston County calendar. It is one of eleven communities on the Go Gaston NC Christmas parade list, and the list shows the Mount Holly date as December 5. The county calendar gives a 3 pm start and no set end time, so the parade may run into the late afternoon.
trains: Mount Holly has no train ride of its own on our list. The Bela Express train rides at the Kings Mountain Christmas Parade and Festival on December 5 are the nearest holiday trains in Gaston and Cleveland counties, and they are carried on our Gastonia page. Gastonia's Christmas Town U.S.A. in McAdenville is another short drive for families who want lights.
